name: backgrounds-43
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a production environment atlas for Reading Adventure.
STYLE REFERENCE image1 is the user-approved forest background. Preserve its organic smooth BLACK outlines, gentle grayscale cel shading, white highlights, rounded illustrated forms, friendly hand-drawn quality and clear storybook depth. Same illustrator, same world. This is NOT pixel art and NOT sterile vector icon art.
LAYOUT: ONE landscape atlas of SIX distinct landscape scenes, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows. Every scene fills its own equal cell all the way to its edges; no gutters, borders, labels, dividers, text or numbering. The overall atlas aspect ratio is 9:4, each scene is 3:2. Use generous resolution.
SHARED CAMERA IN ALL SIX: a wide flat foreground ground plane occupying bottom35%, completely clear in the middle70% for a hero and a pet. Horizon at60% of each cell's height; the two characters' future feet will be at90%. Scene content stays at outer edges and distant background; center above foreground remains mostly white and airy so faces stay readable. No step or ledge under the landing area. No humans, animals, pets or auras anywhere.
All scenes use black fine contours and gray filled shadows with clean WHITE surfaces. Keep backgrounds light, no large black masses, no dark skies. Complexity appears in distant architecture and edge framing, NEVER clutter the foreground. Richness follows scene descriptions but keep details broad and readable at480x320. No ground oval shadow. No grain, dithering, hatch, blur, gradient wash, photorealism or 3D. No lettering or readable symbols. Each scene must be different and exactly follow its description.
SCENES IN ROW-MAJOR ORDER:
1. Cosmic sanctuary: celestial sanctuary with great pale ring structures behind and fine carved side plinths.
2. Empyrean court: elegant wing-shaped balustrades at edges, multiple distant palace tiers, empty central terrace.
3. Palace of dawn: regal divine palace with sun-crescent architecture, pale sky and richly carved edge columns.
4. Hall of gods: immense divine hall with tall carved side pillars and empty raised recess far behind, no people or throne in foreground.
5. Realm of infinity: grand terrace under faraway concentric cosmic arcs, small worlds at horizon, ornate low side railings.
6. Garden of deities: exquisite mythic garden with white flowering trees and elegant celestial architecture at outer edges, open central path.
